claims.evidence: No brand badge, engine code, or cylinder-count marking visible in either photo; witness only identified it generically as a bare car engine with alternator and coils.
No import documents, shipping labels, or VIN/customs stickers are visible in the photos.
Photos are static; no video or audio of the engine running, no compression test shown.
Engine is detached from vehicle; no odometer or mileage documentation visible.
Valve cover and block are visible but no close-up of gasket seams, bolt torque marks, or seals to confirm it hasn't been disassembled.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal faults (knock, low compression, worn bearings)
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start and idle, plus a compression test reading per cylinder

risks.risk: Engine may not match the specific Hyundai/Kia model or trim claimed, causing compatibility issues
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine code/casting number or ECU sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified generic 4-cyl engine, not model-specific

risks.risk: Missing accessories or sensors not visible in these two angles (intake manifold, ECU, sensors, wiring loom completeness)
risks.proof: Additional photos from front/intake side and underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, assume missing parts need sourcing

risks.risk: Mileage/history claims (Tokunbo, Belgium, low mileage) could be fabricated to inflate value
risks.proof: Import/customs paperwork or bill of lading showing origin and mileage, if available
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverifiable, no premium for low mileage or import claim

risks.risk: Hidden corrosion, cracks, or oil/coolant leaks not visible from these two static angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of block seams, gasket areas, and underside
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only verified, mechanical condition unknown

proof_requests: Video of engine cold-starting and idling with audio
Close-up photo of engine code/casting number or VIN sticker
Additional photos showing intake manifold side, underside, and all accessory completeness
Any import/customs documentation supporting Tokunbo/Belgium origin and mileage claim
response.reason: Witness confirms it is a bare used car engine, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified running condition, unverified model match, possibly incomplete) pending the listed proofs.
